purpose: Read-only analysis of archived first-hitting terminal configurations; not a new repair simulation or a CMB fit.
schedules: All16 receipt-listed integer schedules per level, fixed initial-load seed per level.
nulls: white initial loads with declared RNG
same estimator on inherited input; coarse grouping arithmetic conservation
uncertainty: Schedule spread/standard error conditional on one initial field only; no cosmological confidence interval, no spatial-bin iid assumption.
stopping: Complete one pass through each declared archived state; no target-based parameter tuning. Optional stable completed refine states analysed separately.
resource: Reuse existing host, nice10, one process, BLAS1, no bulk local files, no changes to existing run outputs.
nonclaims: no radiation transfer or direct Planck fit
ancestral groups have equal observer count, not identical solid angle
angular pixelization is an estimator with a doubled-latitude-resolution sensitivity check
geometry_only_amendment: Before measuring any terminal field, L8 coverage check found 20 empty pixels in the proposed 256x512 grid. Use 256x256 instead (minimum 5 cells); 128x256 has minimum 17 cells. Longitude sampling stays at 256, sufficient for the declared lmax40 FFT. No interpolation or result-based selection.
